verdict.rationale: Check is an embedded payroll API, so configuring pay schedules is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack never mentions pay schedules, pay frequencies (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly), or assigning different schedules to different teams or workplaces. Documentation covering creating, previewing and approving individual payroll objects is adjacent and does not show recurring schedule configuration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can set up multiple pay schedules (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly) across different teams
